data.description:
## Incident Overview
The socket-guard conftest fixture (bug 1c68 fix) exposed 26 tests across 3 files that make real network calls via urllib/socket without mocking those seams. These were masked previously because no runtime socket guard existed.

**Affected files and failure counts (newly exposed by guard):**
- tests/scripts/test_acli_integration.py — 12 tests fail with RuntimeError: network access forbidden
- tests/scripts/test_bridge_acli_field_coverage.py — 11 tests fail with RuntimeError: network access forbidden
- tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_aggregator.py — 6 tests fail (litellm calls Anthropic API via real socket)

**Root cause class:** Tests mock subprocess.run or AcliClient._run_acli but the code paths also exercise urllib.request.urlopen or litellm.completion without mocking those seams.

**Note:** tests/scripts/test_acli_integration.py is currently being fixed by a parallel agent (bug 1c68). The other two files remain unfixed.

**Expected:** All unit/scripts tier tests pass with the socket guard active (no @pytest.mark.allow_network needed in these tiers).
**Actual:** 26 tests raise RuntimeError from the guard.

## Technical Environment
- Python 3.14.5, pytest 9.0.2
- Guard: tests/conftest.py _dso_network_guard fixture
- Branch: worktree-20260603-084946
data.title: network-guard: tests/scripts acli+bridge+aggregator tests reach live network without socket mock
